combo6.title: Deep-Abyss Dual Floodgate Full Combo
combo6.description: An advanced full-combo Blue-Eyes line opening with Deep-Eyes White Dragon, the Blue Abyss and Maiden of White. The line searches Sage with Eyes of Blue and deploys True Light, Wishes for Eyes of Blue, and Mausoleum of White to mill Blue-Eyes White Dragon and revive Deep-Eyes from the Graveyard. Leveraging Kewl Tune Rotary into Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon, it bridges through Crystron Halqifibrax Prism and Rciela into Dragunity Lord - Georgius equipped with Dragunity Knight - Luin (locking opponent Graveyard effects). Elemental Saga Doriado extends the board into Borreload Savage Dragon and Zalen the Shackled Dragon, ending on an oppressive multi-negate board backed by two Graveyard floodgates, Majesty of the White Dragons, and Infinite Impermanence.
